snippet.title: GlagStone - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
GlagStone is a story-driven 1-bit city builder inspired by late-80s Macintosh aesthetics.

Rebuild a remote northern island settlement caught between warring nations, manage scarce resources, survive rain, snow, fog and darkness — and uncover the mystery at its heart.

Wishlist GlagStone on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4198840/GlagStone/

Official website:
https://glagstone.com

Follow development:
https://x.com/glagstonegame
